summary_bullets: Move /design Step 3 onto a script-internal review loop with durable phase resumes
Apply accepted plan-review findings in-loop through the plan revision waterfall with post-apply safeguards
Document the new loop envelope and cover launcher, phase, cap, and cleanup behavior with harnesses
commit_message:
Internalize design Step 3 review loop

Add a sourced Step 3 loop controller that runs review rounds, applies accepted findings through the plan revision waterfall, and emits a bounded STEP3_REVIEW_LOOP_STATUS envelope for terminal and bail-out outcomes.

Extend run-step3-review.sh with --mode single|loop and --starting-round validation, keep review-round-count.txt ownership in the driver, and make plan-review-loop.sh stateless when --prune-round-num is omitted.

Document the loop/resume contract and add harness coverage for loop envelopes, launcher validation, settled state cleanup, and structural pins.
todos_left: Run the full bash scripts/relevant-checks.sh to completion; the second attempt passed shellcheck, markdownlint, agent-lint, secrets, Bash 3.2, and early lint gates before the tool window elapsed.
